digest.component_or_area: test suite — Jira DC transport and pagination
propositions: Five tests have assertions that cannot fail: PAT-repr tautology, pagination guard re-implements inline instead of calling shared predicate, validate_assignee_exists checks only presence not return type, rate-limit sweep uses <= instead of ==, and unknown-backend test does not exercise select_backend.

Each test's docstring names a real contract that is worth testing, but the test body fails to assert it — either structurally (vacuous logic, missing calls, wrong assertion form) or by incomplete coverage (presence vs. return value).

The shared pagination predicate _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() must be parameterized with an optional source argument to allow the teeth test to feed synthetic unpaginated code, while the production guard call remains unchanged.

Rewritten tests must be mutation-checked by breaking production code (not fixtures) — e.g. adding __repr__ that leaks credentials, dropping keyword checks from the pagination predicate, making validate_assignee_exists return a bool, restoring total <= 1, or pointing select_backend at a known backend — and confirming the test goes RED.
